blocks.text: “The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power” is set to return for its fourth season, Prime Video confirmed after releasing the final two episodes of the hit fantasy TV series’ third season. The streaming service company said the upcoming season is already in pre-production, with filming set to begin at Shepperton Studios in the United Kingdom. “‘The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power’ has become a defining series for Prime Video,” said Amazon MGM Studios’ Head of Global Television Peter Friedlander. “As Season Three delivers the landmark moment fans have been waiting for—the forging of the One […]...
